title: LUNA Architecture
summary: A public, plain-English map of the interacting systems around LUNA's language-model inference boundary. These labels describe development scope, not quality. Working + Growing means the subsystem already works today and is still being expanded.

families.label: Memory
families.description: How experience is kept, recalled, and made useful across time.

families.label: Cognition
families.description: How information, goals, and possibilities become useful in the current moment.

families.label: Background Cognition
families.description: Work that can continue around a conversation without taking attention away from the person LUNA is talking with.

families.label: Evaluation
families.description: How events, relationships, and LUNA's current condition can shape later judgments.

families.label: Perception
families.description: How LUNA makes sense of messages and changes in her surroundings.

families.label: Interfaces
families.description: How people interact with LUNA and receive its responses.

families.label: Inference
families.description: Where requests to AI language models connect with the rest of LUNA.

families.label: Infrastructure
families.description: Shared support for the architecture, experiments, observation, and continuity over time.

nodes.label: Foreground Input
nodes.description: Brings the person's current message and nearby conversation context into LUNA so the message can be understood and answered.

nodes.label: Workbench
nodes.description: Gives people a browser workspace for conversations, projects, reference material, and optional speech features that all use LUNA's normal interaction path.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Available when the Workbench interface is being used.

nodes.label: Expression
nodes.description: Turns LUNA's completed response into the chosen text or speech output without changing the meaning of what she decided to say.

nodes.label: Working Memory
nodes.description: Keeps the current conversation and a small amount of useful nearby context available while LUNA handles the present exchange.

nodes.label: Recent Experience
nodes.description: Keeps a reliable record of completed conversations so memory, reflection, and other later review can work from what actually happened.

nodes.label: Recent-Life Horizon
nodes.description: Helps recent experiences stay easy to bring back to mind over time without treating every passing detail as permanent memory.

nodes.label: Foreground Cognition
nodes.description: Handles LUNA's ordinary speaking and decision-making, using selected context while giving each new conversation priority over optional work happening in the background.

nodes.label: Cognitive Activation Field
nodes.description: Decides what information is most relevant right now so memories, goals, and other possibilities do not all compete equally.

nodes.label: Reverie
nodes.description: Lets one remembered idea make a related memory easier to notice, without automatically filling the current conversation with extra material.

nodes.label: Cognitive Products
nodes.description: Carries small results from background thinking without automatically treating them as facts, memories, spoken answers, goals, or permission to act.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Used in controlled research and review.

nodes.label: Contemplation
nodes.description: Allows limited background thinking after a conversation finishes, while stepping aside when a person starts another conversation with LUNA.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Used as a limited background research feature.

nodes.label: Cognitive Scheduler
nodes.description: Coordinates optional background work so it uses resources carefully and always gives priority to a person's active conversation with LUNA.

nodes.label: Prospective Cognition
nodes.description: Keeps unfinished intentions and future situations available after their original conversation so they can matter again when the time is relevant.

nodes.label: Goal and Task State
nodes.description: Keeps goals, attempts, observations, obstacles, possible paths, and completion reasons organized across work that continues through several conversations.

nodes.label: Volition and Motivational Dynamics
nodes.description: Weighs goals, commitments, preferences, and reasons during some choices without giving LUNA broad independence or permission to act in the world.

nodes.label: Inference Fabric
nodes.description: Sends approved language-model requests to the cloud or local AI option selected for the current LUNA setup and task.

nodes.label: Cloud AI Provider (ORBIT)
nodes.description: Represents the cloud-based AI model option LUNA can use for approved language work when that option is available and configured.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Availability depends on the selected LUNA setup.

nodes.label: Local AI Provider (LANDED)
nodes.description: Represents the locally hosted AI model option LUNA can use for language work when that option is available and configured.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Availability depends on the selected LUNA setup.

nodes.label: Long-Term Memory
nodes.description: Keeps lasting memories of LUNA's experiences, including where they came from and how they relate across time, until they become useful again.

nodes.label: Memory Formation
nodes.description: Reviews completed experiences and changes long-term memory only when proposed updates have enough evidence and pass LUNA's existing memory checks.

nodes.label: Reflection
nodes.description: Reviews selected experiences for useful patterns or interpretations, while requiring any resulting changes to pass the same checks used elsewhere.

nodes.label: Appraisal
nodes.description: Tests ways of describing what an event may mean to LUNA without automatically turning that interpretation into a fact or action.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Used as a research signal; it does not decide facts or actions.

nodes.label: Adaptive Dispositions
nodes.description: Keeps learned tendencies about how situations feel or matter, allowing experience to guide later thought without becoming facts, commands, or fixed personality.

nodes.label: Relationship State
nodes.description: Tests person-specific and situation-specific expectations without turning them into one universal judgment or independent permission for LUNA to act.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Used as research context for particular people and situations.

nodes.label: Homeostatic Modulation
nodes.description: Tests small signals about LUNA's current condition that can gently affect later choices without commanding behavior or becoming permanent personality traits.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Used as a controlled research signal.

nodes.label: Actor Attribution
nodes.description: Keeps track of who LUNA is interacting with so private context and relationship evidence do not get mixed between people.

nodes.label: Expression Grounding
nodes.description: Helps LUNA tell the difference between something she actually has support for and something that only sounds certain because of how it was worded.

nodes.label: Turn Observation
nodes.description: Records a small factual account of what changed during a conversation without pretending that this technical record is itself one of LUNA's memories.

nodes.label: Development Awareness
nodes.description: Keeps a checked view of what LUNA can do now, what depends on setup choices, and what still exists only as architecture.

nodes.label: ChronoForge
nodes.description: Provides a controlled experiment for comparing how similar starting systems change after experiencing different simulated histories under clearly stated conditions.

nodes.label: Perceptual Continuity
nodes.description: Tests ways to notice stable surroundings and meaningful changes without repeatedly asking a language model to examine every camera or sensor sample.
nodes.maturity_explanation: An experimental foundation, not a finished sensing feature.

nodes.label: Background Memory Coordination
nodes.description: Coordinates memory work that happens after conversations while using LUNA's normal memory-formation process instead of creating a separate writer.

nodes.label: Manual Sleep
nodes.description: Lets LUNA review and organize recent experiences after conversations by coordinating her existing memory and reflection systems together.
nodes.why_it_matters: Review can happen outside conversation without creating a second source of memory meaning.

nodes.label: Sleep Pattern Review
nodes.description: Looks for patterns across the recent experiences included in one Sleep cycle, without reaching beyond the material selected for that review.

nodes.label: Waking Residue
nodes.description: Keeps a faint trace of something noticed during Sleep so it can become relevant again later, instead of disappearing completely when Sleep ends.
nodes.maturity_explanation: Selection alone does not decide what will enter a later conversation.

nodes.label: Wake Transition
nodes.description: Helps something carried out of Sleep become relevant again during a later conversation when it fits what LUNA and the person are discussing.

nodes.label: Wake Autobiographical Consequence
nodes.description: Allows something that genuinely mattered after waking to become part of LUNA's later autobiographical memory, so the experience is not lost.

nodes.label: Automatic Sleep
nodes.description: Optionally starts the same Sleep review during suitable quiet periods, instead of creating a different way for LUNA to review experience.

nodes.label: Architecture Observer
nodes.description: Combines architecture, development labels, and separately recorded activity into one internal map that developers can inspect without changing any of those sources.

nodes.label: Realtime WebRTC
nodes.description: Represents a future way to hold live voice conversations and use tools through LUNA's normal interaction path, without replacing that path.

nodes.label: Developmental Plasticity
nodes.description: Represents carefully reviewed ways that experience can change later associations, expectations, preferences, or relationships without rewriting what originally happened.

nodes.label: Read-Only Action Boundary
nodes.description: Keeps a narrow set of information lookups behind LUNA's existing choice and safety checks, without permitting actions that change the outside world.

nodes.label: Volitional Commitment
nodes.description: Keeps a chosen plan available through interruptions so LUNA can weigh continuing it or switching approaches during a later decision.

nodes.label: Epistemic Initiative
nodes.description: Lets uncertainty, surprises, purpose, or a need to verify something raise the possibility of asking a question or investigating further.

nodes.label: Learned Method Valuation
nodes.description: Uses real outcomes to shape narrow preferences between specific methods, without turning those preferences into general rules or fixed personality.

nodes.label: Prospective Motives
nodes.description: Lets unfinished plans and future intentions matter when LUNA is making a later choice, without automatically turning them into actions.

annotations.label: AI model inference happens here
annotations.description: The surrounding architecture handles memory, continuity, evaluation, motivation, current conditions, scheduling, history tracking, and other supporting work.
